name: DCDiag test status
description: Latest test results per computer. Missing or unrecognized results remain unknown.
kql:
DCDiagData_CL
| where Computer in~ (_SelectedSystems)
| where TimeGenerated > ago(_TimePeriod)
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by Computer
| extend Tests = Status
| mv-expand Test = bag_keys(Tests)
| extend TestName = tostring(Test)
| project Timestamp = TimeGenerated, Computer, TestName,
    Result = tostring(Tests[TestName]), Result__Status = tostring(Tests[TestName])
| order by Computer asc, TestName asc
